chapter_title_en: The Little Emperor of Great Qi
chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 571: The Little Emperor of Great Qi – Who Is He Really?
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang discovers the Little Emperor was sent 30 years into the past. His shocking conclusion changes everything about a loyal friend.
og_title: Time Paradox! The Emperor Was There All Along
og_description: A simple villager's story shatters Li Huowang's understanding of the past and reveals the true identity of his most unassuming companion.
twitter_title: Shocking! The Real Emperor Was Under His Nose This Whole Time
twitter_description: Li Huowang connects the dots between a thirty-year-old mystery and his own loyal friend, revealing the Little Emperor of Great Qi.

lore_anchors.definition: A corrupted Nian beast whose power is tied to time itself. It drains yang life on contact, and its red afterimages are theorized to alter a being's temporal position, not just their lifespan.
A twisted expansion of the Buddhist Eight Sufferings, used in the Dao-Twisted World as a cultivation tool for a White Lotus cult. Li Huowang uses it as a supernatural lie detector.
An ontological disaster where a fundamental law of reality ceases to function. Great Qi is currently facing one, giving Li Huowang limited time to find its lost emperor.
Li Huowang's first master and a corrupt alchemist. Though dead, his past actions of kidnapping "simpletons" for alchemy continue to have profound consequences.
A person's allotted lifespan. Supernatural abilities in the Dao-Twisted World often demand payment in yang life, acting as a visceral, non-negotiable cost for using power.
